RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, December 14, 2018/Agrahayana 23, 1940 (Saka)
————
(Ministries :  Agriculture and Farmers Welfare; Chemicals and Fertilizers;
Coal; Communications; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Electronics and Information Technology; Food Processing Industries; Law and
Justice; Railways; Statistics and Programme Implementation)
Total number of questions — 160
111
Infrastructural support and cheap
credit for agriculture sector
481. SHRI K. R. ARJUNAN: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that agriculture
sector needs long-term solutions rather than
temporary loan waiver and free power
supply;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
agriculture sector needs infrastructure
support and cheap credit to improve the
growth;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
agriculture is becoming unviable and people
are abandoning farming and moving into
urban areas; and
(d) if so, the steps proposed to be taken
by Government to prevent this situation?
Assistance to farmers affected by
demonetization
482. SHRI K. R. ARJUNAN: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that millions of
farmers were unable to buy seeds and
fertilizers for winter crops because of
demonetization;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
Government had submitted a report in this
regard;
(c) whether as per the said report, 263
million farmers live mostly in the cash
economy; and
(d) if so, the steps taken by Government
to assist the needy farmers to buy seeds
and fertilizers?

112
Drought in Andhra Pradesh
483. SHRI PRABHAKAR REDDY
VEMIREDDY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Government of Andhra Pradesh had
declared 15 Mandals in Nellore district,
apart from various other Mandals of the
State as drought-prone during Rabi season
2017-18;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
Government of Andhra Pradesh had
requested financial assistance from the
NDRF; and
(c) if so, the amount of funds the State
Government has sought for Nellore and the
recommendations made by the visiting
Central Team and the amount released so
far, for Andhra Pradesh, with particular
reference to Nellore district?
Establishment of Agriculture
University in Andhra Pradesh
484. SHRI C.M. RAMESH: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that as per
provisions of the AP Reorganisation Act,
2014, Central Government shall take steps
to establish an Agriculture University in
Andhra Pradesh, if so, the details thereof;
and
(b) the latest status of the University,
the funds which have been released for
establishing the University and the timeline
for completion thereof along with the details
thereof?
Technology-driven revolution in
agricultural sector
485. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian
agriculture needs a technology-driven
revolution, especially given the extant
challenges of fragmented landholding, low
level of input usage, limited access to
irrigation, absence of extension services and
inadequate linkage to markets; and
(b) if so, the steps Government is taking
to infuse multiple technologies in farming
to transform agriculture from being a means
of livelihood to one of agri-business where
every farmer becomes an entrepreneur?
Assistance to farmers for purchasing
agricultural implements
†486. DR. ASHOK BAJPAI: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government provides
assistance to farmers for purchasing
agricultural implements;
(b) if so, the details thereof for the last
three years, year-wise;
(c) whether the funds allocated for this
purpose have been fully utilized by all State
Governments; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Implementation of drip-irrigation
technologies
487. PROF. M.V . RAJEEV GOWDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the status of implementation of drip-
irrigation technologies, State-wise, district-
wise and panchayat-wise;
